title: Pagination
description: Cursor based pagination for list endpoints.

sections.title: Cursors
sections.content:
Pass the cursor value from the previous response to get the next page.

curl 'https://api.example.org/v1/items?cursor=abc123&limit=50'

sections.title: Limits
sections.content: The default page size is 25 and the maximum is 100. Larger values are clamped silently.
